## Installation & Setup
- Requires [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest). Make sure you are up-to-date. - Download the `.apworld` file below and double-click it to install. Restart Archipelago after installation. - Use **Options Creator** or **Generate Template Options** in the Archipelago Launcher to create player option YAML files. - Place your edited player option YAML files in the `Players` folder. Use **Browse Files...** in the Launcher to open the Archipelago directory. - Make sure you have all required `.apworld` files, your player YAMLs, and any desired `host.yaml` settings ready before generating. (`server_password` is recommended for admin login.) - Click **Generate** to create a multiworld `.zip` in the `output` folder. - Upload the generated `.zip` to https://archipelago.gg/uploads or self-host it. Self-hosting requires port forwarding. - For detailed setup instructions and game-specific documentation, see [game-specific documentation](https://github.com/Panguu/Archipelago-RaCSM/tree/SM-Main/worlds/rac_size_matters/docs). - If you encounter errors, run `ArchipelagoLauncherDebug.exe` or launch Archipelago from a terminal and check the `logs` folder. - Need help? entry.title: wizardoflegend v1.1.0
entry.content:
## [1.1.0] - V1.1.0 Release
### Added - "Teleport to Hub" button in the pause menu to quickly reroll the dungeon. - Perfect boss / miniboss locations, with bosses being optional. - New NPC's Tokens progression item added. - New trap system that queues traps instead of triggering them all at once. - Game items are now reintroduced in shops when no Archipelago locations are left available.
### Changed - Reworked archipelago items by bundling relics and arcanas to have less items. - Rebalanced the APWorld: reduced grindy locations and diversified traps. - NPC locations are now locked behind their associated token requirement. - Refactored `ItemHandler`. - Removed the BouncyCastle proxy dependency.
### Fixed - Max HP Boost no longer resets the player's health when picking a relic inside the dungeon. - Removed potential in-game freezes while sending checks by sending them to the server in a separate thread. - Loop NPC not appearing. - Level locations are now correctly checked even if the player cannot go to the next level. - Group Relics no longer behave erratically. - Various fixes following playtesting, including the Perfect miniboss bug, shop slots and the Collector NPC.
### AI Disclosure - AI assistance was used for learning BepInEx/Harmony modding patterns, and supporting code refactoring. The vast majority of the codebase was authored by hand..

entry.title: Final Fantasy VIII v0.10.0
entry.content:
## What's new in v0.10.0
- **Laguna's first dream no longer freezes story checks.** The dream rewinds the story counter and v0.9.0's story-jump guard held story checks and the goal for everyone who played it attached. The client now recognises the dream, and a hold v0.9.0 left behind lifts itself on connect. - **Fixes (work on v0.9.0 seeds):** - Weapon Remodel / Ultimate Weapon checks fired when a recipe was listed in the junk shop; they now need the weapon in hand. - First Draw now counts for spells the multiworld sent you, and enemy casts no longer count as your draws. - Key: Lunar Gate and Key: Sorceress Memorial opened each other's door (older seeds are corrected on connect). Centra Ruins doors re-lock right after a battle. - A used Magical Lamp came back. - `/ff8warp esthar` landed inside the city model, and an owned ship now follows a warp. - Spell names in menus and battle. - A closed game left the client "Attached". - `/ff8` shows the seed's difficulty options. - Archipelago 0.6.8 supported (0.6.7 still works). - **Magic economy (new seeds, checks-only magic):** `<Spell> Stock` items for every spell but Apocalypse (Scan included), sized so a seed's magic adds up to the new **Magic Abundance** option (25–300%, default 150% of what the party can hold). About a third of spells arrive a tier early or late. - **Logic (new seeds):** - The Queen of Cards needs every key she can stand behind. - Draw points re-homed: Auditorium Double on Disc 1, the four "Centra Excavation Site" points to Lunatic Pandora, Laguna's second dream as one-time, the Fire Cavern world point. - Enemies Scanned 15/25, new check Siren Learns ST Med-RF, GF Abilities Learned 135. - **Client window:** a new **FF8** tab with every command as a button. - **Tracker 0.16.0** (PopTracker 0.34+): precise maps drawn from the game's world data, an overhead floor plan per town with every check at its real spot, and the tracker follows you into towns.
v0.9.0 seeds keep working with this client; the magic and logic changes need a new seed. Full write-up: [announcement](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/release/v0.10.0-announcement.md), [FAQ](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/faq.md), [player guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).
## Install
1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher. 2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder. 3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.
### Visual Tracker
`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:
1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher. 2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it. 3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.
Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!
Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).
## What's Changed * Release v0.10.0: Laguna dream fix, weapon remodel and First Draw fixes, magic economy, FF8 client tab, precise tracker maps by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/12
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0

entry.title: Manic Miners v1.6.0
entry.content:
_**Manic Miners v1.6**_ brings a slew of client and QoL updates!
The v1.6 client is incompatible with v1.5-generated games, and vice versa.
Major changes: * Client overhaul! Informational client commands are replaced by full UI tabs. * Integrated YAML-less Universal Tracker into client! No need to have UT open separately, or have the original YAML to hand. * Item Groups and Location Groups! Support for grouped AP functionality added, so you can hint for 'Levels' for example instead of a specific one, have 'Vehicles' all in start_hints, or blanket exclude all locations from a given level at once. * Seed protection and save management - no more seed bleed! The MM client will automatically validate and cycle your save files when connecting to slots. Provided you only have one copy of the client open at once, you can freely cycle between slots without restarting! * EnergyLink! Turn your surplus crystals into power for the multiworld. (One-way only - the LMS Explorer can only run on crystals.) * Optional behaviour changes when locations are !collected by other players! Prevents needing to replay !collected levels locally if that's your preference. * Petting a slug is now a location! This is clearly the most important change.
Minor changes: * Research Coordinates locations are not made if CoordinatesUnlocked is set to true * Boss levels during Coordinate Hunt, which inherently have time and crystal targets disabled, no longer display time or crystal information. * YAML auto-adjustments are logged in the generation output * Various client or apworld bug/typo fixes

entry.title: UZDoom v0.9.0
entry.content:
# 0.9.0
This is probably the biggest release so far. While most of it was focused on internal improvements to better handle complicated total conversions (work that will continue in the next version), it also comes with new features. The full changelog is below, but the headline features are:
- **For players:** - Support for per-map weapons, and better weapon handling in general - Significant improvements to the YAML, including WAD-aware comments - In-game UI improvements - Support for four new megaWADs and two new total conversions - Experimental support for [UZDoom 5.0.x](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/setup.md#uzdoom-50x-support) - **For logic developers:** - Improvements to the in-game logic dashboard - Ability to add comments to the tuning record using in-game chat - Support for turning items that spawn mid-game into checks, such as boss drops - New [GZAPRC directives](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/gzaprc.md)
🛈 [Logic pack downloads](../../blob/84f6e054436519f47601b8ab175943516f3068b7/gzap/doc/support-table.md)
⚠️ YAML options have changed. You must regenerate your YAML templates.
⚠️ Item categorization rules and the included scanner configurations have changed. Rescanning your wads is not *mandatory* but is *strongly recommended*.
⚠️ Tuning format has changed. You do not need to redo all your custom tuning. Old files can be upgraded to the new format via find-and-replace: `,"event","exit"` -> `,"exit"`.
- New: - `per_map_weapons` yaml setting. If enabled, a different copy of each weapon is added to the pool for each map. To use a weapon on a given map you need to find the corresponding version of it in the pool first. - If this is enabled, the level select screen will show you which weapons have been unlocked in each map. - Weapons can now be hinted and toggled on and off from the inventory screen. - Errors caused by mismatches between the generating apworld and the pk3 loaded during play should now produce a slightly more obvious error at game startup. - `--slot` and `--wad` command line flags for the client. - Experimental UZDoom 5.0.x support; see [setup.md](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/setup.md#uzdoom-50x-support). - Complete logic and tuning for `BTSX E2`, by Sayeth. - Complete logic and tuning for `Rise of the Wool Ball`, by Xindage. - Complete logic and tuning for `Alien Vendetta`, `Ancient Aliens`, and `Hellevator`, by Halcyon. - Complete logic and tuning for `Ashes 2063 Enriched Edition`, by ToxicFrog. - For logic developers: - Chat messages starting with `;` will be inserted into the tuning file as comments, rather than sent to other players. - Support for checks that only spawn partway through the level, e.g. boss loot and crafting/puzzle outputs. - See [events.md](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/design/events.md) for documentation. - `Adventures of Square` now uses this for the floppy disk drops in E1A9 and the hexagon key drop in E2A11. - Simple HUD for logic developers showing map, last checked location, region name, and region prereqs. Enable with `ap_show_logic_hud`. - `replacement` and `episode` directives in `GZAPRC`. See [gzaprc.md](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/gzaprc.md). - Changed: - Major overhaul of the yaml options. - Many settings that previously had to be controlled by editing the `included_item_categories` are now their own toggles or sliders. - `included_item_categories` is still present to support less common use cases not covered by the separate options. - Item-related settings now tell you how many checks turning a category on or off will add or remove, along with what items belong to that category in the current wad. - Major overhaul of item categorization. Filler should now all have a size (`big`, `medium`, or `small`), and one or more kinds (`health`, `armor`, `ammo`, `attack`, `defence`, or `tool`). See [categories.md](../../blob/uzap-0.9.0/gzap/doc/categories.md) for details. - As a result of the above, many item categories have changed. `medium-armor` is now actually used, and many things previously considered `powerup` or `tool` now have proper sizing and more specific categories. - Redesign of the weapon suppression system. It should now be much more reliable, both at blocking weapons you shouldn't have and at permitting weapons you should. - Redesign of how weapons are granted to you by AP. Once you receive a weapon it will try very hard to make sure you always have it. If you have a weapon replacer mod loaded it will remember whatever the weapon turned into and keep that in your inventory instead. - Redesign of weapon logic. It is now deterministic. This is still a work in progress. - If per-map weapons are enabled, only those weapons required for combat logic (or explicitly in the logic) are Progression; other weapons are Useful. - Internal redesign of how exit and secret locations are handled. Future work in this area will support randomizing items into exits and implementing spawn-based checks. - Tuning data now uses `[map,"exit"]` for exit events rather than `[map,"event","exit"]`. - Hub map has a new look. (No interactivity, just shiny.) - Client should now be much more robust about UZDoom restarting (even with a different game loaded!) while the client stays running. - Fixed: - MAP31 and MAP32 were incorrectly excluded from 1000 Lines 2. - Adventures of Square logic is now aware of the previously-missing "Totally Square" and "Cubular" difficulty levels. Checks that exist only on those difficulties may lack tuning data. - Doom 1/2, Heretic, Chex Quest, and Faithless no longer have ammo pickups with duplicate names. - If the apworld generates a pk3 that requires items the engine doesn't know about, it will now crash on startup with an explanatory message rather than crashing confusingly later. - The apworld no longer crashes during option construction if the default settings don't contain enough locations for reliable solo-play generation even with all maps. - Entering a level will now scan for checks that were picked up but never received by the server (e.g. because the client disconnected) and re-send them all. - A yaml configuration that produces more progression items than there are locations to place them will now produce an OptionError rather than (likely) failing generation later. - `get_filler_item_name()` now works again (and the generated filler is weighted based on its prevalence in the item pool). - Region names are now taken into account when deciding if location names are unique. - AP will no longer send you extra copies of keys whenever you load a saved game. - If disallowed weapons are configured to `turn into ammo`, but we can't figure out what ammo to spawn, the weapon is left on the floor rather than deleted outright. - Reported spawn filter name when generating was incorrect. (Behaviour was fine, just the log messages were wrong.)

entry.title: Mario Tennis GBC v0.3.0
entry.content:
## New options
- **DeathLink**, as two independent options, both off by default. You can change either while playing with the client's `/deathlink_send` and `/deathlink_receive` commands. - **`death_link_send`** (off, point, game or match): the smallest loss that sends a death. - A lost match point is still only one death. - A failed mini-game or drill counts as a lost match, and a failed drill point as a lost point. - **`death_link_receive`** (off, point, game or match): what a received death costs you in a match. - A lost game in a tiebreak takes the set with it. - Any death ends a mini-game or drill as failed. The exception is a high-score run already past its record, which ends as a high score. - Deaths that arrive outside a match, mini-game or drill are ignored. - Two-on-One counts as a match for both options. - **`court_shuffle`** (default vanilla): the courts story matches are played on. - **Shuffled:** the story's own courts are dealt out between its matches, so each court is played as often as usual, in different matches. - **Randomized:** every match picks its own court from the nine exhibition courts and Center Court. - **`opponent_strategy`** (default vanilla): where singles story opponents stand and move. In the original game every one of them uses the same adaptive positioning. - **Randomized:** each singles match's opponent gets one of the game's eight positioning strategies, such as staying back at the baseline, sliding sideways or rushing the net. - Their skill is unchanged. - Doubles opponents always keep their usual positioning.
## Logic
With `shot_items` on, three drills now strictly need a shot instead of counting as glitched logic without it:
- **Net Game Lesson 2** needs the smash. - **Stroke Match 2** needs the lob. - **Net Game Match 2** needs the smash. Clearing it without the lob is still glitched logic.
There are still 88 locations.

entry.title: Spelunky 2 v0.5.0
entry.content:
This is an update to both APworld + Client. Huge architectural changes mean that _**ALL**_ previous versions _WILL NOT WORK_. # What's new ## The game mod itself The entire thing has been re-written from the ground-up to make future coding changes far more sustainable and more granular. For a general player, you shouldn't notice almost anything different except for... ## Friendlier locked-out items Hedjet / Crown / Ankh -- previously they would be replaced upon the level loading and getting near them -- now they will "be replaced" but still exist safely until you collect it's replacement; This can mean you are just about to pick up that Bomb bag then suddenly it'll become a Crown in time because you receive it from the multiworld! _(Not YET for the HouYi Bow or Light Arrow, more R&D required)_ ## Deathlink black-listing John Celeste keeps dying and has no Amnesty? Now you can choose to stop accepting deathlinks from them and play in peace! ## "CO" goal can now be 7-5 After quite some discussion I've been convinced to make this change. One thing to be aware; the goal is that you enter the exit OF your goal level (So a goal of 7-5 means you go through the exit OF 7-5 to meet your goal) ## Deathlink taken into account for logic! If you have deathlink on, you are not _logically_ expected to send the "spikes" or "ghost" journal entries until you have an ankh (or telepack, in the instance of the spikes) -- no deaths needed! ## Some new "sent location" icons! Just a tiny bit of visual feedback adjustments but now there is a graphical distinction between "useless" filler, "helpful" filler, and "HELPFUL" progression. Thanks again 'activegalacticnuclear' aka 'Ganymede' for these!! ## new "Must visit world" setting For those that want shortcuts to require not just access, but also having visited them :) ## Receive "Upgrades" mid-run! During any run if you receive an upgrade, it'll be granted to you (if it's a normal one) or added to waddler (if it's a waddler one) rather than needing to wait for a new run. This respects your "journal entry" and "locked" item settings you choose. ## Unknown extras! Due to how long this has taken there's probably a bunch of other small happy changes I've made and failed to document. Oopsies!
_**Note:**_ Deathlink messages will refer to a "WIP message", it's something I plan to fully address and handle in a future update but this one has taken FAR too long and caused crashes for FAR too long. I needed it out sooner rather than later.
## Bug Fixes! - Send deathlinks even though you are already dead _(D'oh!)_ - Boss Doors causing a crash _**ACTUALLY FOR REAL THIS TIME**_ - Broken Sword logic not accounting for access to Clone Gun (who'da thunk you need to actually be able to get it... Oops) - _ALL_ locked out items being considered "in logic" _(I was setting the wrong rule and quietly suppressing an error... ugh)_ - Eggplant being able to send it's check despite not being unlocked - Probably SEVERAL more
# Huge thanks and respect to [Eszenn](https://github.com/Eszenn/) for piloting the original implementation, best of wishes to them. ## Big thanks still goes to @cloiss + (discord) ``activegalacticnucleus`` for their contributions to 0.3.0

entry.title: Pokemon HGSS Singe v0.11.0
entry.content:
# Pokemon HGSS Singe APWorld v0.2.6
**New seeds needed** (APWorld version 0.2.6). A seed generated with v0.2.5 keeps working with the v0.2.5 apworld: finish it with that one, and generate new seeds with this one. The BizHawk Client warns you when a seed and the installed apworld do not match.
## Files
- `poke_hgss.apworld`: the world. Put it in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder. - `Poke_HGSS.yaml`: the default options file, ready to edit. - `poke_hgss_tracker.html`: web tracker, open it in your browser (double-click).
## How to update
1. Delete the old `poke_hgss.apworld` from `custom_worlds`, then add this one (the Launcher's "Install APWorld" does not overwrite an existing file). 2. Your YAML keeps working. The new options below are all off by default. 3. Generate a new seed.
## Highlights
- **Logic overhaul.** Every map was walked on the ROM's own collision data (HeartGold and SoulSilver, identical results) and every story lock was checked against the game's scripts: caves, cut trees, boulders, water and story events now ask for exactly what the game needs. - **Items no longer lost**: the count of delivered items now lives in the save, so a reload, a game closed without saving or a battle running when an item arrives no longer loses it. - **Weekday and night events are permanent**, so a check never depends on the day or the hour. - **New quality of life options**, off by default: - `running_shoes_at_start` and `map_card_at_start`: the Cherrygrove Guide Gent's gifts from the start, useful with a random start; - `fly_points_at_start`: every Johto town is a Fly destination (not part of the logic); - `item_received_messages`: "Received X from Bob" on the BizHawk screen. - **Web tracker** redrawn after the game's own Town Map, with in-game icons and Gym Leaders you can tick by hand.
## Fixes
- Player reports: Clear Bell and Tidal Bell, TM78 "Game Corner JP", items missing from the save, items lost during a battle, the "Bag data looks wrong" message, Jasmine ignoring the Secret Potion, "File hash does not match" with a trimmed US ROM, DeathLink, the Olivine Lighthouse, the Sudowoodo and the Squirtbottle, randomized trainers keeping their old moves. - Radio Tower takeover, Mom at New Bark Town's east shore, `johto_only`, Dexsanity tables, badges found on the ground, Blackthorn Gym's TM59, Super Rod, Coin Case and Basement Key. - Logic loosened where the map allows it: Ice Path B2F and B3F, Monica on Route 40. - Olivine Gym's TM23 and the Department Store B1F Amulet Coin now ask for what the game really needs; the MooMoo Farm checks show as conditional in the trackers. - Patching is about 50 s faster.
Full details in `CHANGELOG.md`.
## Use of an LLM
This project is developed with the help of an LLM. Every change is reviewed, the main files are read, and fixes are tested in game on HeartGold and SoulSilver before release. Details in the README.
Thanks You all for your FeedBack !!!!
## Next time
- `Shop_sanity` : shop will can containt somes Item from Archipelago - Upgrade of `Randomizer_chart_sanity` -> APCheck for each Weakness\Efficiency detecte
Have nice day !!!
